newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power next-day prices little changed.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power next-day prices little changed.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) made slight changes to the hours applicable to peak prices, but Tuesday prices were unchanged from offers slated for Monday schedulings, the federal power marketing agency said Monday.
Bonneville offered electricity between hours 0800 and 2100 PDT on Tuesday at $20.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for firm and $19.00 non-firm, compared with hours 1000-2100 on Monday.
Volumes during those hours continue to be limited to 200 megawatts.
Prices for the hour ending 0700 and 2200-2300 were $18.00 per MWh (firm), and $17.00 (non-firm).
BPA continued to offer power during hours 0100-0600 and the hour ending 2400 PDT at $13.00 per MWh.
